question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 30 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 31 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of students = 31 × 30 = 930

New total (including teacher) = 32 × 31 = 992

Teacher’s age = 992 − 930 = 62

**∴ Answer = 62 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 31, Average = 30; New average = 31

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of students = 31 × 30 = 930

⇒ Total age including teacher = 32 × 31 = 992

⇒ Teacher’s age = 992 − 930 = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number

Total Calculation

Total = Average × Number

Increment Method

Extra total = Increase in average × new number

Quick Tip

Teacher’s age = increase in total after inclusion
